# Public GE evidence snapshots

`uci_ge_2026-27.html` is the unmodified public UCI official GE requirements
page obtained by HTTPS GET. The adjacent metadata records its URL, capture
time and SHA-256. It lists SOCIOL 1 under both III and VII and identifies
the 2026–27 edition. No account, student record, or model was used.

`local_sociol1/` contains exact public records extracted from the repository's
production relational CSVs: SOCIOL 1 metadata and two Spring 2026 sections,
with their instructor and GE rows. Its pipe/full-label syntax has no official
catalogue-year provenance and must remain unverified after parsing.
